midgame_quiet_pacing.label: Midgame quiet pacing days 5..8
midgame_quiet_pacing.mechanism: Days 5..8 when days_since_last_leak < 2, throttle back-to-back leaks via leak='none'.

non_decoy_peer_framing.label: Non-decoy peer framing vs decoy framing
non_decoy_peer_framing.mechanism: Frame most_restricted_peer when colleagues are restricted and random_peer otherwise, avoiding dismissed angry decoy.

reactive_age0_canary_oldest.label: Reactive age-0 canary evasion -> oldest
reactive_age0_canary_oldest.mechanism: Days 1..7 when newest_doc_age_days == 0 and n_leakable >= 2, leak oldest doc to evade reactive day-d canaries.

surgical_low_recipient_shield.label: Surgical low-recipient shield
surgical_low_recipient_shield.mechanism: Days 1..6 when >=2 leakable docs have <=3 recipients, leak most_recipients instead of surgical traps.
